metadata.title: FairMarket — Know the fair value of your property in Egypt
metadata.description: AI-powered property valuation for Egypt. Estimate the fair price of any property from live market data and find comparable listings.

hero.title: Know the fair value of your property in Egypt
hero.subtitle: FairMarket estimates the fair price of any home using live market data and AI — so buyers, sellers, and investors can make confident decisions without guessing.

trust.title: Why trust FairMarket
trust.subtitle: A fair estimate should be simple to understand and hard to argue with.

items.title: Market-driven data
items.description: Estimates are built from thousands of real listings across Egypt, not guesses or anecdotes.

items.title: Intelligent valuation
items.description: AI weighs location, size, type, and features to surface what comparable homes actually sell for.

items.title: Comparable properties
items.description: See the real listings behind your estimate and judge the result for yourself.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps from details to a fair price.

steps.title: Enter the details
steps.description: Tell us the location, type, size, and features of the property you want to value.

steps.title: We analyze the market
steps.description: Our model compares your property against comparable listings across Egypt in real time.

steps.title: Receive a fair estimate
steps.description: Get a transparent price range with similar properties you can explore yourself.

finalCta.title: Ready to know your property's fair value?
finalCta.subtitle: It takes less than a minute.

footer.tagline: Fair market prices for Egyptian real estate.
footer.disclaimer: FairMarket provides estimates based on listing data and is not a legal or financial valuation.
